what: Digests of every kit 31203 output: the 8 bundled recipes x combinations A, B, C built from the dataset fixtures (tests/fixtures/datasets) through the CLI commands (research R9, SC-001). Compared by tests/integration/test_kit_outputs_unchanged.py. First written from an unmodified checkout of main at commit 6038d9c, without any feature 016 production change (re-based once, on 2026-11-23, from af3ce57: only the 24 preview.png digests changed). Regenerated once, on 2026-11-24, when feature 016 (branch 016-map-templates at f33b464) was merged into feature 017 (map stickers): 017 appends the sticker tables the project owner approved on 2026-11-24 to the eight bundled recipes, which changes every recorded recipe SHA-256 and the checksums derived from it (layout, report, cells, parts lists, estimate, section counts, sheets SVG and PDF: 248 digests); no other output changed (see regenerated).
generator: PYTHONPATH=tools .venv/bin/python -m maptemplates kit-golden --fixtures --out tests/fixtures/golden/kit_outputs.json (run from cli/)

code.note: the kit outputs of commit 6038d9c's library code: the merged tree reproduces this file's previous version byte for byte on the af3ce57 recipe bytes (regenerated.proof), so the file holds 6038d9c's kit outputs with feature 017's recipe checksums

regenerated.reason: feature 017's approved sticker tables (a '# Map stickers (feature 017):' line and a [sticker] table appended to each bundled recipe) change the recipe SHA-256 recorded in every output
regenerated.proof: before rewriting, the same harness ran on the merged tree with the eight bundled recipes replaced by their bytes before the sticker block (cli/tests/integration/stickers_guard.py prefix_bytes; SHA-256 equal to af3ce57's, guard G1): its document equalled the previous file byte for byte; feature 017's guards G1-G4 passed unchanged
regenerated.supersedes: 016's rule that this file is only written from an unmodified checkout of main; T054's proof procedure replaces it for this regeneration
